confirmedFindings.title: Strict Priority Load Balancing Overloads Primary Trunk
confirmedFindings.body: Replacing weighted round-robin with unconditional selection of `trunks[0]` directs 100% of outbound enterprise traffic to a single trunk group, exhausting its channel capacity and causing call rejections.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Restore weighted round-robin or capacity-aware load balancing across available healthy trunk groups.
